node.statement: Lemma 3.3 (Random purification formula): The Haar average over purifications gives: (Schur^{tensor 2}) E_{|rho_bar>}[|rho_bar><rho_bar|^{tensor n}] (Schur^{tensor 2})^dag = sum_{lambda: ell(lambda)<=r} dim(lambda) |lambda,lambda><lambda,lambda|_{YY'} tensor |EPR_lambda><EPR_lambda|_{PP'} tensor nu_lambda^d(rho)_Q tensor (I/dim(V_lambda^r))_{Q'}. Proof: Write random purification as (I tensor U)|rho_0>, average |u><u|^{tensor n} over U Haar on U(r). By Lemma 3.2, U acts only on the Q' register. By Schur's lemma, E_U[U^{tensor n} A (U^dag)^{tensor n}] kills cross-terms (lambda != mu) and replaces the Q' content with I/dim(V_lambda^r).
